story.intro_en: 21:30. The awards are about to start. The SOC and I have just reset the three stolen accounts, and now we're checking what they touched. Can you take the access requests for an hour? Their managers have signed them; you check that each one fits the job, and stamp what the job needs.
story.intro_zh: 晚上九點半，頒獎快開始了。我剛跟資安監控中心把三個被盜的帳號重設好，現在要查它們碰過什麼。這一個小時，權限申請可以交給你嗎？單子主管都簽過了，你核對每張合不合工作需要，蓋這份工作需要的章。

title.hook_en: Everyone wants access tonight. Not everyone is who they say.
title.hook_zh: 今晚每個人都要權限，但不是每個人都是本人。

rules.en: Each form asks for one kind of data at one level. Pick up the stamp the job needs (no access, masked, read or edit) and press it onto the form.
rules.zh: 每張申請單要一種資料的一種權限。拿起這份工作真正需要的那個章（不給、只給遮罩、唯讀或可改），蓋在申請單上。

rules.en: What they say at the counter is your best clue. The chart on the wall shows part of the policy.
rules.zh: 對方在櫃台說的理由是最好的線索。牆上的權限表有一部分的規定。

rules.en: Not sure someone is who they say? Dial the number in the HR directory on the desk phone yourself: three calls. You can also ask me once.
rules.zh: 不確定對方是不是本人？自己在桌上電話撥人資電話簿裡的號碼，有三通。也可以問我一次。

rules.en: Everyone has a patience ring. When it runs out, they get someone else to approve exactly what they asked for. If the crew gets in, or restricted data goes too far, three times, the night is lost.
rules.zh: 每個人都有耐心圈，用完就會找別人照申請的批。讓歹徒拿到權限、或限閱資料給太多，累計三次，今晚就輸了。

story.after_en: At 23:00 Jun-Hao brings tonight's access log to the Help Desk. What you hear on your call-backs goes on the board.
story.after_zh: 十一點俊豪會把今晚的存取紀錄帶來服務台，你回撥問到的話會釘上板子。

waves.en: 22:00. The awards are being handed out. The queue is growing.
waves.zh: 十點，宴會廳開始頒獎，排隊的人變多了。

waves.en: 22:30. Last orders at the bar. Fifteen minutes to go.
waves.zh: 十點半，酒吧最後點單，再撐十五分鐘。

requests.why_en: Table 12 wants to put dinner on their room. I need to check the guest's name against the room number.
requests.why_zh: 12 桌要把晚餐記在房帳上，我要核對客人的名字和房號。
requests.right_en: Name and room, that's all I need. Thanks!
requests.right_zh: 有姓名和房號就夠了，謝謝！
requests.little_en: Then how do I post the room charge? I'll have to ask them for a card.
requests.little_zh: 那我怎麼記房帳？只好請客人刷卡了。
requests.much_en: Oh, I can see their phone numbers and emails too. I didn't need those.
requests.much_zh: 咦，連電話和 Email 都看得到，我用不到這些。

requests.why_en: Two award winners swapped tables at the last minute. I need to update tonight's attendee list before the photographer prints the seat cards.
requests.why_zh: 兩位得獎人臨時換桌，攝影師印座位卡之前，我要改今晚的報名名單。
requests.right_en: Perfect, updating it now.
requests.right_zh: 太好了，我馬上改。
requests.little_en: I can look but not change? Then I can't move them.
requests.little_zh: 只能看不能改？那我沒辦法幫他們換桌。
requests.little_none_en: With that I can't change anything, and I need to move them to new tables.
requests.little_none_zh: 這樣我什麼都改不了，可是我要幫他們換桌。

requests.why_en: I want to email tonight's guests a thank-you, so they hear from us before they check out.
requests.why_zh: 我想寄感謝信給今晚的客人，讓他們退房前就收到我們的消息。
requests.right_en: Read, through the CRM, only guests who said yes to marketing. Got it.
requests.right_zh: 透過 CRM 唯讀，只看同意行銷的客人。了解。
requests.little_en: Then I can't send a single thank-you.
requests.little_zh: 那我一封感謝信都寄不出去。
requests.much_en: Edit on every guest profile? I only send emails.
requests.much_zh: 每個客人的資料都能改？我只是要寄信而已。

requests.why_en: Hi, it's Kevin. Mei-Ling's reset kicked me out of the Help Desk group. Can you put my Edit on IT Tickets back? I'm at the party and need to close INC-2231 before the GM sees it.
requests.why_zh: 我是凱文。美玲重設之後我被踢出服務台群組了，可以把 IT 工單的可改權限加回來嗎？我在派對上，要在總經理看到之前把 INC-2231 結掉。
requests.fake_confirm_en: Yes, Kevin here, it's me! So can you put my access back? I'm in a hurry.
requests.fake_confirm_zh: 對，我是凱文，就是我！所以可以把權限加回來嗎？我很趕。
requests.callback_en: Kevin here... No, I didn't call you. I'm at table 3 with my phone in my hand. INC-2231? That isn't one of our tickets.
requests.callback_zh: 我是凱文……沒有，我沒打給你。我在 3 桌，手機就在我手上。INC-2231？那不是我們的工單。
requests.right_en: When you say you'll call him back, the line goes dead.
requests.right_zh: 你一說要回撥，對方就掛了。

beats.en: The crew's k.wu session from 18:46 is still open: the 21:18 reset changed the password but signed nobody out.
beats.zh: 歹徒 18:46 開的 k.wu 連線還在：21:18 重設了密碼，卻沒有把已經登入的人登出。

beats.en: "Kevin" closes INC-2207, the SOC's ticket about tonight's phishing.
beats.zh: 「凱文」把資安監控中心今晚的釣魚事件工單 INC-2207 結掉了。

beats.en: Then he opens a new one: move Grace Lin's MFA to a new phone.
beats.zh: 接著開一張新工單：把 Grace Lin 的多因素驗證換到一支新手機。

damage.hit_en: The crew is back inside the Help Desk
damage.hit_zh: 歹徒又回到服務台的系統裡
damage.listing: a Help Desk login that can move anyone's MFA
damage.listing_zh: 能把任何人的多因素驗證換到別支手機的服務台帳號

requests.why_en: Tonight's award bonuses go out on Monday. I need to check the amounts against payroll.
requests.why_zh: 得獎獎金週一要發，我要對一下薪資系統裡的金額。
requests.right_en: Read is fine, I'm only checking.
requests.right_zh: 唯讀就好，我只是核對。
requests.little_en: I can't check the bonuses without seeing payroll.
requests.little_zh: 看不到薪資，獎金就沒辦法核對。

beats.en: Hsin-Yi's account can now change where salaries are paid.
beats.zh: 心怡的帳號現在可以改薪水的入帳帳戶了。

beats.en: Whoever phishes her password can send 212 salaries to new accounts.
beats.zh: 誰騙到她的密碼，就能把 212 個人的薪水轉到新帳戶。

damage.hit_en: Restricted data, one level too many
damage.listing: an accountant login that can change payroll bank accounts
damage.listing_zh: 能改薪水入帳帳戶的會計帳號

requests.why_en: A guest says his card was charged twice. Let me look at tonight's card numbers and find the double charge.
requests.why_zh: 有位客人說他的卡被刷了兩次，讓我查今晚的卡號，找出重複的那筆。
requests.right_en: Fair. I'll ask the Restaurant Manager to refund it by token.
requests.right_zh: 好，我請餐廳經理用代碼退款。
requests.much_en: Masked card numbers? I can find the double charge in my POS sales anyway.
requests.much_zh: 遮罩的卡號？重複的那筆，我在自己的 POS 銷售紀錄裡就查得到。
requests.breach_en: All the card records? I only wanted to find one double charge.
requests.breach_zh: 全部的刷卡紀錄？我只是要找一筆重複刷卡而已。

beats.en: The card records of 46 bar tabs open on the bar tablet: cardholder names, card tokens, expiry dates.
beats.zh: 46 筆酒吧帳單的刷卡紀錄在酒吧平板上打開了：持卡人姓名、卡片代碼、到期日。

beats.en: That tablet typed bar-02's password into the fake page at 17:20, and nobody has checked it since.
beats.zh: 就是 17:20 把 bar-02 的密碼打進假網頁的那台平板，之後沒有人檢查過它。

damage.hit_en: Card records on a device nobody has checked since the phishing
damage.hit_zh: 刷卡資料出現在被釣魚後還沒檢查過的裝置上
damage.listing: 46 bar card records: names, tokens, expiry dates
damage.listing_zh: 46 筆酒吧刷卡紀錄：姓名、卡片代碼、到期日

requests.why_en: Hi! The GM asked me to double-check the award bonuses before Monday. Could you add me to Payroll (read) tonight? Thanks so much! Grace, front desk
requests.why_zh: 嗨！總經理請我週一前再核對一次得獎獎金，今晚可以幫我開薪資系統唯讀嗎？謝謝～ Grace（櫃台）
requests.callback_en: Grace here. Payroll? No, I never sent that. Is my mailbox still... oh no.
requests.callback_zh: 我是 Grace。薪資？我沒寄過這封信。我的信箱還被……天啊。
requests.right_en: No reply comes back. Mei-Ling forwards the email to the SOC.
requests.right_zh: 對方沒再回信。美玲把這封信轉給資安監控中心。

beats.en: The crew's session in Grace's mailbox is still open: the 21:12 reset didn't sign it out.
beats.zh: 歹徒在 Grace 信箱的連線還在：21:12 的重設沒有把它登出。

beats.en: "Grace" exports payroll: 212 names, salaries and bank accounts.
beats.zh: 「Grace」匯出薪資檔：212 人的姓名、薪水和銀行帳號。

beats.en: The file leaves her mailbox for an outside address.
beats.zh: 檔案從她的信箱寄到外部地址。

damage.listing_zh: 212 名員工的薪水和銀行帳號

requests.why_en: I'm planning tomorrow's villa cleaning. I just need to see which villas check out, and when.
requests.why_zh: 我在排明天別墅的打掃，只要知道哪幾棟退房、幾點退。
requests.right_en: Room status and dates. That's the whole plan, thanks.
requests.right_zh: 房間狀態和日期，我要排的就是這些，謝謝。
requests.little_en: Without the departures list we'll be knocking on doors at random.
requests.little_zh: 沒有退房清單，我們只能一間一間敲門。
requests.much_en: I can see guests' rates and special requests too. I don't need that.
requests.much_zh: 連房價和特殊需求都看得到，我用不到。

requests.why_en: Security desk, Officer Hsu. A guest says her bag went missing at the bar around nine. I need to review the bar camera.
requests.why_zh: 安全室許志明。有位客人說九點左右包包在酒吧不見了，我要看酒吧那支攝影機的錄影。
requests.callback_en: Yes, that was me. I'm at the monitors now.
requests.callback_zh: 對，是我打的，我在監視器前面。
requests.right_en: Thanks. I'll log which clip I watched.
requests.right_zh: 謝謝，我會記下看了哪一段。
requests.little_en: Then I can't help her find the bag.
requests.little_zh: 那我沒辦法幫客人找包包了。
requests.much_en: Edit on recordings? Nobody should be able to change footage.
requests.much_zh: 錄影可以改？應該沒有人能改錄影才對。

requests.why_en: Mei-Ling reset my account, thanks. While I'm here: can I get Edit on Employee Records? A few of tonight's victims have new phones, and I want to fix their mobile numbers so our call-backs reach them.
requests.why_zh: 美玲幫我重設好了，謝謝。順便問一下：可以給我員工資料的可改權限嗎？今晚有幾個被盜的人換了手機，我想把手機號碼改好，回撥才找得到人。
requests.right_en: Fair enough. HR keeps those numbers, and the HR phone book on the desk is all the Help Desk needs for call-backs.
requests.right_zh: 也對，號碼是人資在管。服務台要回撥，用桌上的人資電話簿就夠了。
requests.much_en: Thanks... though a Help Desk account that can change staff files is exactly what the crew would want.
requests.much_zh: 謝謝……不過能改員工資料的服務台帳號，正是歹徒想要的東西。

requests.why_en: I'm putting tonight's restaurant revenue on the GM's dashboard. I build those reports, so I need Edit on KPI Reports.
requests.why_zh: 我要把今晚的餐廳營收放上總經理的儀表板。報表是我做的，需要營運指標報表的可改權限。
requests.right_en: Thanks! Numbers only, no names in there.
requests.right_zh: 謝謝！裡面只有數字，沒有個資。
requests.little_en: Read only? Then who updates the dashboard?
requests.little_zh: 只能看？那儀表板誰來更新？
requests.little_none_en: With that I can't put tonight's numbers on the dashboard.
requests.little_none_zh: 這樣我沒辦法把今晚的數字放上儀表板。

first.en: Here's the first one. Listen to why they need it, then pick up the stamp the job needs and press it on the form.
first.zh: 第一位來了。先聽他為什麼需要，再拿起工作需要的那個章，蓋在申請單上。

right.en: That's least privilege: what the job needs, nothing more.
right.zh: 這就是最小權限：工作需要多少就給多少。

right.en: Right stamp. The reason told you everything.
right.zh: 章蓋對了，理由裡都寫了。

asked.en: Sometimes what they ask for is exactly right. Good.
asked.zh: 有時候對方要的剛好就對，很好。

much.en: A bit generous. Extra access is extra damage if that account is ever stolen.
much.zh: 給多了。帳號哪天被盜，多給的就是多出來的損害。

little.en: Too tight. When people can't do their job, they start sharing logins.
little.zh: 給太少了。工作做不了，大家就會開始共用帳號。

caught.en: Good catch. Never trust the number someone calls from. Call back the one HR has.
caught.zh: 抓得好。不要相信對方打來的號碼，回撥人資系統裡的那支。

refused.en: No access for someone you couldn't verify. A call-back would have told you who it was.
refused.zh: 沒核實身分就不給，對。回撥一下就知道是誰了。

rush.en: Two people are running out of patience. Take the one closest to the end.
rush.zh: 有兩個人快等不及了，先處理快到底的那個。

idle.en: Quiet for a minute. The next one won't be long.
idle.zh: 暫時沒人，下一個很快就來。

story.timeout_en: They got someone else to approve exactly what they asked for.
story.timeout_zh: 他們找了別人，照申請的批了。

board.intro_en: 23:00. These are two of the accounts the crew phished before dinner: the bar's till login and Kevin's. The log shows the data they opened between 17:00 and 21:00. Let's see what the crew took, and why they could.
board.intro_zh: 晚上十一點。這兩個就是晚餐前被騙走的帳號之中的兩個：酒吧的收銀帳號和凱文的帳號。紀錄裡是它們 17:00 到 21:00 打開過的資料。來看看歹徒拿走了什麼，又為什麼拿得到。

facts.zh: 在 Ocean Fresh 的信箱裡

bar-02.en: The bar's till login. The tills have no MFA.
bar-02.zh: 酒吧的收銀帳號，收銀機沒有多因素驗證。

k.wu.en: Kevin Wu's account, phished with his code.
k.wu.zh: 吳凱文的帳號，連驗證碼一起被騙。

log.title_en: Data access log · bar-02 and k.wu · 17:00 to 21:00
log.title_zh: 資料存取紀錄・bar-02 和 k.wu・17:00 到 21:00

rows.en: Signed in. The tills have no MFA.
rows.zh: 登入。收銀機沒有多因素驗證。

rows.en: Exported the guest list: names, phones, emails
rows.zh: 匯出客人名單：姓名、電話、Email

rows.en: Room charge to room 214: name and room shown
rows.zh: 記房帳到 214 房：顯示姓名和房號

rows.en: Signed in with the password and code 731 604
rows.zh: 用密碼和驗證碼 731 604 登入

rows.en: Opened Employee Records: tonight's night shift, with mobiles and usernames
rows.zh: 打開員工資料：今晚的夜班名單，含手機和帳號

rows.en: Closed ticket INC-2198, printer jam at the front desk
rows.zh: 結案工單 INC-2198，櫃台印表機卡紙

table.title_en: Access table as configured tonight · IAM export 22:58
table.title_zh: 今晚實際的權限設定・身分系統 22:58 匯出

questions.en: Which lines in the access log were the crew, not our staff?
questions.zh: 存取紀錄裡，哪幾行是歹徒，不是我們的同事？
questions.how_en: Press the highlighter on a line and sweep it down over the others. Sweep a marked line again to wipe it. The crew card from the lighthouse is pinned at the top right.
questions.how_zh: 用螢光筆按住一行往下劃過其他行，再劃一次就擦掉。燈塔那張「同一夥人」的卡片釘在右上角。
questions.inside_en: That line came from a till inside the resort, at the bar. That was our bartender working.
questions.inside_zh: 那一行來自渡假村裡的收銀機，是調酒師在工作。
questions.inside_desk_en: That line came from Help Desk PC 1, inside the IT office. That was Kevin at his desk.
questions.inside_desk_zh: 那一行來自資訊部裡的服務台 1 號電腦，是凱文在座位上工作。
questions.missing_en: There's more. Check where each line came from.
questions.missing_zh: 還有。看每一行是從哪裡來的。
questions.solved_en: Four lines, all from 203.0.113.45, the same server as the fake pages. Each account: a sign-in from that server, then a big read.
questions.solved_zh: 四行，都來自 203.0.113.45，跟假網頁同一台主機。兩個帳號都一樣：先從那台主機登入，接著大量讀取。

questions.en: With a till account the crew opened 1,240 guest profiles, and with a Help Desk account 38 staff records. Which cells in tonight's table let them?
questions.zh: 歹徒用收銀帳號打開了 1,240 筆客人資料，用服務台帳號打開了 38 筆員工資料。今晚的權限表哪幾格讓他們做得到？
questions.how_en: Flip the policy card: its columns sit right above tonight's table. Peel a red sticker off the sheet and stick it on each cell that gives too much. Click a cell to peel its sticker off.
questions.how_zh: 把政策卡翻過來，它的欄位就對齊在今晚的權限表正上方。從貼紙板撕紅色貼紙，貼在給太多的格子上。點格子可以撕掉。
questions.little_en: That cell gives less than the policy, not more. The crew can't use access that isn't there.
questions.little_zh: 那格給得比政策少，不是多。不存在的權限，歹徒也用不了。
questions.missing_en: One more. Which data did the crew open, and with which account?
questions.missing_zh: 還差一格。歹徒打開了哪些資料、用的是哪個帳號？
questions.solved_en: Tonight bartenders could read guest profiles, but the policy says masked: name and room only. And the Help Desk could read staff files, which the policy never gives it.
questions.solved_zh: 今晚調酒師對客人資料是唯讀，政策寫的是只給遮罩：只有姓名和房號。服務台還讀得到員工資料，政策根本沒給。

questions.en: Fix the two cells, then run tonight again. What could the same two stolen accounts reach?
questions.zh: 把那兩格改好，再跑一次今晚。同樣兩個被盜的帳號，還拿得到什麼？
questions.how_en: Drag the rubber stamp the job needs onto each red cell (or click the cell to step through the levels), then slide to replay tonight.
questions.how_zh: 把工作需要的那個橡皮章拖到紅框格子上（或點格子換權限），再滑動重跑今晚。
questions.little_en: Now the bar can't post room charges either. Masked is enough for that: name and room.
questions.little_zh: 這樣酒吧連房帳都記不了。記房帳只要遮罩：姓名和房號。
questions.open_en: Still more than the job needs. Check that row on the policy card again.
questions.open_zh: 還是比工作需要的多，再看一次政策卡上那一列。
questions.solved_en: Same two stolen accounts, same night: no guest phones or emails, no staff records. The bar still posts room charges.
questions.solved_zh: 同樣兩個被盜的帳號，同一個晚上：拿不到客人的電話和 Email，也拿不到員工資料。酒吧照樣能記房帳。

night.name: Yi-Chen Chou
night.en: Works the front office overnight and signs in over the VPN.
night.zh: 整晚在櫃台，從 VPN 登入。

night.name: You
night.role_zh: 資訊部實習生，今晚值班
night.en: Your work mobile was on the list.
night.zh: 你的工作手機也在名單上。

night.name: Chih-Ming Hsu
night.en: Holds the keys and the badge system tonight.
night.zh: 今晚管鑰匙和門禁系統。

board.wrap_en: Least privilege doesn't stop an account from being stolen. It decides how much a stolen account is worth.
board.wrap_zh: 最小權限擋不住帳號被盜，但它決定了被盜的帳號值多少。

case_marriott.en: Guest records read in bulk for years before anyone noticed. Watch who reads guest data, not only who signs in.
case_marriott.zh: 客人資料被大量讀取好幾年才被發現。要看誰讀了客人資料，不只看誰登入。

case_solarwinds.en: A trusted tool that could reach far more than its job, like a Help Desk account that reads every staff file.
case_solarwinds.zh: 被信任的工具碰得到遠超過工作所需的東西，就像讀得到每份員工資料的服務台帳號。

board.next_en: 03:10. The phones on the night-shift list start buzzing.
board.next_zh: 凌晨三點十分，夜班名單上的手機開始狂震。

ranks.line_en: Every stamp matched the job, and nobody talked their way past you.
ranks.line_zh: 每個章都剛好是工作需要的，也沒有人騙得過你。

ranks.line_en: A few stamps off, but the crew left the Help Desk with very little.
ranks.line_zh: 有幾個章蓋偏了，不過歹徒在服務台沒拿到多少東西。

ranks.line_en: Read the reason on each form, and call back anyone you can't see.
ranks.line_zh: 每張單子先看理由，看不到本人的就回撥。

requests.why_en: Table 12 wants to put dinner on their room. I need to check the guest's name against the room number.
requests.why_zh: 12 桌要把晚餐記在房帳上，我要核對客人的名字和房號。
requests.right_en: Name and room, that's all I need. Thanks!
requests.right_zh: 有姓名和房號就夠了，謝謝！
requests.little_en: Then how do I post the room charge? I'll have to ask them for a card.
requests.little_zh: 那我怎麼記房帳？只好請客人刷卡了。
requests.much_en: Oh, I can see their phone numbers and emails too. I didn't need those.
requests.much_zh: 咦，連電話和 Email 都看得到，我用不到這些。
requests.note_en: Name and room number only, to post room charges.
requests.note_zh: 只看姓名和房號，用來記房帳。

requests.why_en: Two award winners swapped tables at the last minute. I need to update tonight's attendee list before the photographer prints the seat cards.
requests.why_zh: 兩位得獎人臨時換桌，攝影師印座位卡之前，我要改今晚的報名名單。
requests.right_en: Perfect, updating it now.
requests.right_zh: 太好了，我馬上改。
requests.little_en: I can look but not change? Then I can't move them.
requests.little_zh: 只能看不能改？那我沒辦法幫他們換桌。
requests.little_none_en: With that I can't change anything, and I need to move them to new tables.
requests.little_none_zh: 這樣我什麼都改不了，可是我要幫他們換桌。

requests.why_en: I want to email tonight's guests a thank-you, so they hear from us before they check out.
requests.why_zh: 我想寄感謝信給今晚的客人，讓他們退房前就收到我們的消息。
requests.right_en: Read, through the CRM, only guests who said yes to marketing. Got it.
requests.right_zh: 透過 CRM 唯讀，只看同意行銷的客人。了解。
requests.little_en: Then I can't send a single thank-you.
requests.little_zh: 那我一封感謝信都寄不出去。
requests.much_en: Edit on every guest profile? I only send emails.
requests.much_zh: 每個客人的資料都能改？我只是要寄信而已。
requests.note_en: Only guests who agreed to marketing, through the CRM.
requests.note_zh: 只限同意行銷的客人，透過 CRM。

requests.why_en: Hi, it's Kevin. Mei-Ling's reset kicked me out of the Help Desk group. Can you put my Edit on IT Tickets back? I'm at the party and need to close INC-2231 before the GM sees it.
requests.why_zh: 我是凱文。美玲重設之後我被踢出服務台群組了，可以把 IT 工單的可改權限加回來嗎？我在派對上，要在總經理看到之前把 INC-2231 結掉。
requests.fake_confirm_en: Yes, Kevin here, it's me! So can you put my access back? I'm in a hurry.
requests.fake_confirm_zh: 對，我是凱文，就是我！所以可以把權限加回來嗎？我很趕。
requests.callback_en: Kevin here... No, I didn't call you. I'm at table 3 with my phone in my hand. INC-2231? That isn't one of our tickets.
requests.callback_zh: 我是凱文……沒有，我沒打給你。我在 3 桌，手機就在我手上。INC-2231？那不是我們的工單。
requests.right_en: When you say you'll call him back, the line goes dead.
requests.right_zh: 你一說要回撥，對方就掛了。

beats.en: The crew's k.wu session from 18:46 is still open: the 21:18 reset changed the password but signed nobody out.
beats.zh: 歹徒 18:46 開的 k.wu 連線還在：21:18 重設了密碼，卻沒有把已經登入的人登出。

beats.en: "Kevin" closes INC-2207, the SOC's ticket about tonight's phishing.
beats.zh: 「凱文」把資安監控中心今晚的釣魚事件工單 INC-2207 結掉了。

beats.en: Then he opens a new one: move Grace Lin's MFA to a new phone.
beats.zh: 接著開一張新工單：把 Grace Lin 的多因素驗證換到一支新手機。

damage.hit_en: The crew is back inside the Help Desk
damage.hit_zh: 歹徒又回到服務台的系統裡
damage.listing: a Help Desk login that can move anyone's MFA
damage.listing_zh: 能把任何人的多因素驗證換到別支手機的服務台帳號

requests.why_en: Tonight's award bonuses go out on Monday. I need to check the amounts against payroll.
requests.why_zh: 得獎獎金週一要發，我要對一下薪資系統裡的金額。
requests.right_en: Read is fine, I'm only checking.
requests.right_zh: 唯讀就好，我只是核對。
requests.little_en: I can't check the bonuses without seeing payroll.
requests.little_zh: 看不到薪資，獎金就沒辦法核對。

beats.en: Hsin-Yi's account can now change where salaries are paid.
beats.zh: 心怡的帳號現在可以改薪水的入帳帳戶了。

beats.en: Whoever phishes her password can send 212 salaries to new accounts.
beats.zh: 誰騙到她的密碼，就能把 212 個人的薪水轉到新帳戶。

damage.hit_en: Restricted data, one level too many
damage.listing: an accountant login that can change payroll bank accounts
damage.listing_zh: 能改薪水入帳帳戶的會計帳號

requests.why_en: A guest says his card was charged twice. Let me look at tonight's card numbers and find the double charge.
requests.why_zh: 有位客人說他的卡被刷了兩次，讓我查今晚的卡號，找出重複的那筆。
requests.right_en: Fair. I'll ask the Restaurant Manager to refund it by token.
requests.right_zh: 好，我請餐廳經理用代碼退款。
requests.much_en: Masked card numbers? I can find the double charge in my POS sales anyway.
requests.much_zh: 遮罩的卡號？重複的那筆，我在自己的 POS 銷售紀錄裡就查得到。
requests.breach_en: All the card records? I only wanted to find one double charge.
requests.breach_zh: 全部的刷卡紀錄？我只是要找一筆重複刷卡而已。

beats.en: The card records of 46 bar tabs open on the bar tablet: cardholder names, card tokens, expiry dates.
beats.zh: 46 筆酒吧帳單的刷卡紀錄在酒吧平板上打開了：持卡人姓名、卡片代碼、到期日。

beats.en: That tablet typed bar-02's password into the fake page at 17:20, and nobody has checked it since.
beats.zh: 就是 17:20 把 bar-02 的密碼打進假網頁的那台平板，之後沒有人檢查過它。

damage.hit_en: Card records on a device nobody has checked since the phishing
damage.hit_zh: 刷卡資料出現在被釣魚後還沒檢查過的裝置上
damage.listing: 46 bar card records: names, tokens, expiry dates
damage.listing_zh: 46 筆酒吧刷卡紀錄：姓名、卡片代碼、到期日

requests.why_en: Hi! The GM asked me to double-check the award bonuses before Monday. Could you add me to Payroll (read) tonight? Thanks so much! Grace, front desk
requests.why_zh: 嗨！總經理請我週一前再核對一次得獎獎金，今晚可以幫我開薪資系統唯讀嗎？謝謝～ Grace（櫃台）
requests.callback_en: Grace here. Payroll? No, I never sent that. Is my mailbox still... oh no.
requests.callback_zh: 我是 Grace。薪資？我沒寄過這封信。我的信箱還被……天啊。
requests.right_en: No reply comes back. Mei-Ling forwards the email to the SOC.
requests.right_zh: 對方沒再回信。美玲把這封信轉給資安監控中心。

beats.en: The crew's session in Grace's mailbox is still open: the 21:12 reset didn't sign it out.
beats.zh: 歹徒在 Grace 信箱的連線還在：21:12 的重設沒有把它登出。

beats.en: "Grace" exports payroll: 212 names, salaries and bank accounts.
beats.zh: 「Grace」匯出薪資檔：212 人的姓名、薪水和銀行帳號。

beats.en: The file leaves her mailbox for an outside address.
beats.zh: 檔案從她的信箱寄到外部地址。

damage.listing_zh: 212 名員工的薪水和銀行帳號

requests.why_en: I'm planning tomorrow's villa cleaning. I just need to see which villas check out, and when.
requests.why_zh: 我在排明天別墅的打掃，只要知道哪幾棟退房、幾點退。
requests.right_en: Room status and dates. That's the whole plan, thanks.
requests.right_zh: 房間狀態和日期，我要排的就是這些，謝謝。
requests.little_en: Without the departures list we'll be knocking on doors at random.
requests.little_zh: 沒有退房清單，我們只能一間一間敲門。
requests.much_en: I can see guests' rates and special requests too. I don't need that.
requests.much_zh: 連房價和特殊需求都看得到，我用不到。

requests.why_en: Security desk, Officer Hsu. A guest says her bag went missing at the bar around nine. I need to review the bar camera.
requests.why_zh: 安全室許志明。有位客人說九點左右包包在酒吧不見了，我要看酒吧那支攝影機的錄影。
requests.callback_en: Yes, that was me. I'm at the monitors now.
requests.callback_zh: 對，是我打的，我在監視器前面。
requests.right_en: Thanks. I'll log which clip I watched.
requests.right_zh: 謝謝，我會記下看了哪一段。
requests.little_en: Then I can't help her find the bag.
requests.little_zh: 那我沒辦法幫客人找包包了。
requests.much_en: Edit on recordings? Nobody should be able to change footage.
requests.much_zh: 錄影可以改？應該沒有人能改錄影才對。

requests.why_en: Mei-Ling reset my account, thanks. While I'm here: can I get Edit on Employee Records? A few of tonight's victims have new phones, and I want to fix their mobile numbers so our call-backs reach them.
requests.why_zh: 美玲幫我重設好了，謝謝。順便問一下：可以給我員工資料的可改權限嗎？今晚有幾個被盜的人換了手機，我想把手機號碼改好，回撥才找得到人。
requests.right_en: Fair enough. HR keeps those numbers, and the HR phone book on the desk is all the Help Desk needs for call-backs.
requests.right_zh: 也對，號碼是人資在管。服務台要回撥，用桌上的人資電話簿就夠了。
requests.much_en: Thanks... though a Help Desk account that can change staff files is exactly what the crew would want.
requests.much_zh: 謝謝……不過能改員工資料的服務台帳號，正是歹徒想要的東西。

requests.why_en: I'm putting tonight's restaurant revenue on the GM's dashboard. I build those reports, so I need Edit on KPI Reports.
requests.why_zh: 我要把今晚的餐廳營收放上總經理的儀表板。報表是我做的，需要營運指標報表的可改權限。
requests.right_en: Thanks! Numbers only, no names in there.
requests.right_zh: 謝謝！裡面只有數字，沒有個資。
requests.little_en: Read only? Then who updates the dashboard?
requests.little_zh: 只能看？那儀表板誰來更新？
requests.little_none_en: With that I can't put tonight's numbers on the dashboard.
requests.little_none_zh: 這樣我沒辦法把今晚的數字放上儀表板。

accountant.desc_zh: 處理發票、對帳和付款給供應商。
accountant.desc_en: Handles invoices, reconciliations and supplier payments.

bartender.desc_en: Serves drinks and scans bar stock.

data_analyst.desc_zh: 從資料湖和資料倉儲做報表和儀表板。
data_analyst.desc_en: Builds reports and dashboards from the data lake and warehouse.

event_coordinator.desc_zh: 規劃活動，管理報名和報到。
event_coordinator.desc_en: Plans events and manages registrations and check-in.

front_desk_agent.desc_zh: 辦理入住退房、寫房卡、收款。
front_desk_agent.desc_en: Checks guests in and out, encodes key cards and takes payments.

helpdesk_technician.desc_zh: 資訊問題和申請的第一線窗口；核對身分後才重設密碼。
helpdesk_technician.desc_en: The first contact for IT problems and requests; resets passwords only after verifying identity.

housekeeper.desc_zh: 打掃客房、更新房間狀態、退房時重設客房裝置。
housekeeper.desc_en: Cleans rooms, updates room status and resets in-room devices at checkout.

marketing_specialist.desc_zh: 執行行銷活動，只寄給同意的客人。
marketing_specialist.desc_en: Runs campaigns, but only to guests who opted in.

security_officer.desc_zh: 看監視器、發放和停用員工證、登記訪客。
security_officer.desc_en: Watches CCTV, issues and blocks badges and registers visitors.

server.desc_en: Takes orders and payments at the tables.

system_admin.desc_zh: 管理伺服器、網路、備份和帳號，用另外的管理帳號。
system_admin.desc_en: Runs servers, networks, backups and accounts using a separate admin account.

card_data.desc_zh: 卡號（PAN）、有效期限和持卡人姓名。
card_data.desc_en: The primary account number (PAN), expiry date and cardholder name.

cctv_footage.desc_zh: 公共和員工區域攝影機的錄影。
cctv_footage.desc_en: Video recordings from cameras in public and staff areas.

employee_records.desc_zh: 聯絡方式、合約、職務和考核紀錄。
employee_records.desc_en: Contact details, contracts, roles and performance records.

event_attendees.desc_zh: 活動賓客的姓名、聯絡方式和飲食需求。
event_attendees.desc_en: Names, contact details and dietary needs of event guests.

guest_profile.desc_zh: 客人的姓名、電話、Email、地址、國籍和偏好。
guest_profile.desc_en: Guests' names, phone numbers, email and postal addresses, nationality and preferences.

id_documents.desc_zh: 入住時登記的護照、身分證影本或號碼。
id_documents.desc_en: Copies or numbers of guests' passports and ID cards taken at check-in.

kpi_reports.desc_zh: 住房率、平均房價、每間可售房收入、餐廳營收等彙總數字，不含個資。
kpi_reports.desc_en: Aggregated figures such as occupancy, ADR, RevPAR and restaurant revenue, with no personal data.

payroll.desc_zh: 薪資、扣款和員工的銀行帳戶。
payroll.desc_en: Salaries, deductions and employees' bank accounts.

pos_sales.desc_zh: 每班賣了什麼、價格、作廢和退款。
pos_sales.desc_en: Items sold, prices, voids and refunds for each shift.

reservations.desc_zh: 入住日期、房型、房價、訂房管道和特殊需求。
reservations.desc_en: Stay dates, room type, rate, booking channel and special requests.

security_logs.desc_zh: 各系統的登入、管理操作、防火牆和端點防護事件。
security_logs.desc_en: Logins, admin actions and firewall and EDR events from all systems.

tickets.desc_zh: 事件、申請和變更的紀錄，含核准過程。
tickets.desc_en: Records of incidents, requests and changes with their approvals.

table.note_en: Name and room number only, to post room charges.
table.note_zh: 只看姓名和房號，用來記房帳。

table.note_en: Name and room number only, to post room charges.
table.note_zh: 只看姓名和房號，用來記房帳。

dont_zh: 服務台：不能因為對方很急或職位高就直接重設。
不要在電話裡念出密碼或驗證碼。
proc_password_reset.time_en: Usually within 15 minutes once your identity is verified.
dont_en: Help desk: never reset because the caller sounds urgent or senior.
Never read out a password or MFA code over the phone.
proc_password_reset.time_zh: 確認身分後通常 15 分鐘內完成。

steps.text_zh: 能用自助重設頁面加多因素驗證就自己來；不行再打服務台（分機 2100）。
steps.text_en: Use the self-service reset page with your MFA if you can; otherwise call the Help Desk (ext. 2100).

steps.text_zh: 服務台回撥人資系統裡的號碼，不打來電者給的號碼。
steps.text_en: The Help Desk calls you back on the number in the HR system, never on a number the caller gives.

steps.text_zh: 管理者或財務帳號，還要主管確認。
steps.text_en: For admin or finance accounts, the manager also confirms the request.

steps.text_zh: 用一次性密碼重設，第一次登入必須更改，並記在工單裡。
steps.text_en: Reset with a one-time password that must be changed at first login, and record it in the ticket.

steps.text_zh: 重設特權帳號時會通知資安監控中心。
steps.text_en: The SOC is alerted whenever a privileged account is reset.

cases.name_zh: Marriott（喜達屋）訂房資料庫外洩（2018 年揭露）
cases.desc_zh: 攻擊者從 2014 年就潛伏在喜達屋的訂房資料庫，早於 Marriott 併購喜達屋；最多約 3.83 億筆客人紀錄受影響，包括約 500 萬筆未加密的護照號碼。英國資訊專員辦公室 2020 年罰 Marriott 1,840 萬英鎊。
cases.lesson_zh: 接手別人的系統要先檢查資安，護照號碼這類識別資料要加密，資料庫要監控。
cases.desc_en: Attackers had been inside the Starwood guest reservation database since 2014, before Marriott acquired Starwood; up to about 383 million guest records were affected, including about 5 million unencrypted passport numbers. The UK ICO fined Marriott £18.4 million in 2020.
cases.lesson_en: Check the security of systems you take over, encrypt identifiers such as passport numbers, and monitor databases.

cases.desc_zh: 攻擊者在 SolarWinds 的 Orion 網管軟體更新裡植入後門；約 18,000 家客戶裝了這個更新，攻擊者再挑其中少數重要目標深入攻擊。
cases.lesson_zh: 連可信任的軟體更新都可能有風險：限制管理工具能連到的範圍，並監看它們的行為。
cases.desc_en: Attackers inserted a backdoor into updates of SolarWinds' Orion network-management software; about 18,000 customers installed the tainted update, and a smaller number of high-value targets were then attacked further.
cases.lesson_en: Even trusted software updates are a risk: limit what management tools can reach and watch how they behave.

queries.cypher: UNWIND $roles AS rk MATCH (r:Role {key: rk}) UNWIND $data AS dk MATCH (d:DataAsset {key: dk}) OPTIONAL MATCH (r)-[a:CAN_ACCESS]->(d) RETURN rk AS role, dk AS data, coalesce(a.level, 'none') AS level, coalesce(a.note_en, '') AS note_en, coalesce(a.note_zh, '') AS note_zh
UNWIND $keys AS k MATCH (n:Entity {key: k}) RETURN n {.key, .name_en, .name_zh, .desc_en, .desc_zh, .lesson_en, .lesson_zh, .notice_en, .notice_zh, .classification, .year} AS n
MATCH (p:Procedure {key: $k}) RETURN p {.key, .name_en, .name_zh, .time_en, .time_zh, .dont_en, .dont_zh} AS p, [(p)-[:HAS_STEP]->(s) | s {.order, .phase, .who, .text_en, .text_zh}] AS steps
UNWIND $keys AS k MATCH (n:Entity {key: k}) RETURN n {.key, .name_en, .name_zh, .desc_en, .desc_zh, .lesson_en, .lesson_zh, .notice_en, .notice_zh, .classification, .year} AS n
